purpose: Compare released-gradient local-cut versus full temporal backpropagation with identical neurons, task information, clocks, optimiser and objective. Conventional PPO is an external recipe comparator, not an isolated gradient comparison.

source.curriculum: Unchanged long-control near/mid/native phase boundaries 32768/65536/final; actual environmental frames, not network substeps.
source.selection: Unchanged 3 repeats x 20 native source starts, frozen/adaptive independently cloned source checkpoint per repeat, 45 decisions maximum. Reset neuron state at episodes; head filter retained across episodes as declared released convention; fresh whole network state at each selection repeat.

observation.representation: Unchanged frozen source-calibrated image/contact/action/reward belief scaffold plus 2 deterministic posterior-coordinate means
observation.privileges: 400 labelled open-arena views, known room dimensions and allocentric own-action/contact model. No target layout pose/goal labels at inference.

network.detach_old_spikes: Only local-cut recurrent current and voltage reset. Own-neuron adaptation retains old spike derivative.

learning.objective: A2C n-step reverse-scan returns, no GAE/PPO clipping/advantage normalisation
learning.reduction: Released sums with batch-mean voltage penalty; regularisers include bootstrap observation.
learning.final_short_window: Use actual remaining decisions; no excess physical steps.
learning.state: Carry detached neural/readout state between updates; recompute bootstrap observation as first frame of next window.
learning.reset: Neuron reset flag tiled across all 5 substeps of first episode frame; head filter not reset, matching reviewed source convention.

selection.rule: For each method choose one global rate maximising adaptive success count across 3 seeds/repeats/starts (180 trials); ties frozen success then lower registered rate index.

deviations: 252 frozen source inputs replace spiking CNN; omit CNN skip features
Adam updates per 100-decision window replace released default episode-synchronous gradient accumulation
Task and reward differ; this is not an Atari score reproduction

claims.local_cut: Explicit-trace-equivalent windowed gradient reference; software uses stop-gradient autodiff, not online backprop-free hardware.
claims.full_bptt: Same forward pass; temporal recurrent/reset credit paths retained.
claims.cost: Report actual frames/substeps/spikes, weights/optimizer/state/buffer/scaffold memory and estimated ops; no joules/whole-agent energy or universal forgetting claim.
claims.biology: No measured brain mechanism and no actual biological native-data fit in this source comparator.

checks: Independent root rerun of same-forward, explicit-trace and smooth-forward finite-difference tests
All-arm technical dry with independently replayed selection probabilities/values and physics
Full physical budget accounting including shortened final window and all forced curriculum boundaries
Bound current code/protocol/cache/driver/auditor/output hashes and root GO before full fits
failure_policy: Preserve nonfinite/failed/partial cases; no silent retry or seed replacement. No full-fit score until all12 end and independent audit completes.
boundary: Source only. No native or digital target layouts8–25, no shared biological/agent transfer, no manuscript success/submission claim.
